lines.zh: 我踩着空气走，脚不沾地
lines.en: I walk on air; my feet never touch ground.

lines.zh: 红皮肤在太阳下很显眼
lines.en: Red skin shows plainly in the sun.
One dash and I'm over there.
In flight I like to swing wide.

lines.zh: 白头发被风吹得往后飘
lines.en: My white hair streams back in the wind.

lines.zh: 我一边飞一边打量下面
lines.en: I scan the ground as I fly.
The formation must hold; I keep pace.
I drop low, skimming the treetops.
Speed is what I'm good at.
I surge forward, then stop dead.

lines.zh: 这一路没遇上对手，无聊
lines.en: No opponents on this route. Boring.

lines.zh: 我侧着身飞，看着像滑行
lines.en: I fly on my side, like gliding.
Arms folded, I hover in place.

lines.zh: 我在等你先动，好看清路数
lines.en: I wait for you to move so I can read you.
This is a little too quiet.
I smooth my hair.

lines.zh: 风一停，我就有点不自在
lines.en: When the wind stops, I feel off.

lines.zh: 战斗力四万，我可不算弱
lines.en: Forty thousand in power — hardly weak.
I roll my wrists and loosen up.
A ki stirs far off, tiny.

lines.zh: 我在心里排了一遍队形
lines.en: I run the formation through my head.

lines.zh: 这地方的地面我不喜欢
lines.en: I don't care for the ground here.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，没什么理由
lines.en: I smirk, for no particular reason.
Hovering costs me less than walking.
I wonder who breaks first.

lines.zh: 我的气收得很紧，不外泄
lines.en: I keep my ki tight, not letting it leak.
You stand steady. Good act.
Red hair. Fierce enough?

lines.zh: 你身上没有气，怎么打的
lines.en: You've no ki at all. How do you fight?
Relax; I haven't moved yet.

lines.zh: 你这身打扮，是来旅游的？
lines.en: Dressed like that, are you sightseeing?
I raise a hand — just greeting you.
Your eyes are hunting for an exit.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人这么盯着
lines.en: I don't like being stared at like that.

lines.zh: 我往左飘了一点，看你怎么反应
lines.en: I drift left to see how you react.

lines.zh: 你比我想的要沉得住气
lines.en: You've more nerve than I expected.

lines.zh: 要打就快点，我时间不多
lines.en: If we're fighting, hurry. I'm busy.
Remember my face — the red one.
What's funny? Am I amusing?

lines.zh: 我抬手抱拳，行了个队礼
lines.en: I raise a fist in our squad's salute.

lines.zh: 你的气息在抖，我听见了
lines.en: Your breath is shaking. I hear it.

lines.zh: 再看三秒，我就当你挑衅
lines.en: Three more seconds and I take it as a challenge.
All right, you're somewhat interesting.
I rise a little, to look down on you.
I dodged, but not fast enough.
That caught my shoulder.
I slide back half a block.
My grin froze for a moment.
A white line now crosses my red skin.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩被打中的手臂
lines.en: I shake out the arm that was hit.

lines.zh: 血从嘴角流下来，我抹掉
lines.en: Blood at my mouth; I wipe it away.

lines.zh: 我受了伤，速度还是我的
lines.en: Wounded, but speed is still mine.
Now I'd better get serious.
You landed one. Congratulations.
Food? I'm not short of it.
You're holding that up. Seriously?

lines.zh: 我摇头，这东西不合我口味
lines.en: I shake my head; not to my taste.

lines.zh: 要是酒，我可能还会过来
lines.en: If it were a drink, I might come over.

lines.zh: 我凑近闻了一下就退了
lines.en: I lean in, sniff, and pull back.
Don't try to buy me with food.
I don't eat before a fight.
Save it for yourself.

lines.zh: 我瞥了一眼，提不起兴趣
lines.en: One glance, and I lose interest.

lines.zh: 这东西换不来我的时间
lines.en: That won't buy my time.
Move — I'm flying low.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你肩膀还好吗
lines.en: You bumped me. Is your shoulder all right?
I slip aside easily.
I'll pass right by you — don't move.
Tight space; I hold my speed back.
You're the one who ran into me.
I block with my elbow.
Steady — don't fall into my arms.
I back off half a block to let you through.

lines.zh: 这种磕碰，连热身都不算
lines.en: This bump isn't even a warm-up.

lines.zh: 队友是一起活着回来的
lines.en: Teammates are the ones who come back alive.

lines.zh: 我不谈这个，战场上没空
lines.en: Not that. No time for it in battle.

lines.zh: 你要是同伴，我护你后背
lines.en: If you're with me, I'll guard your back.

lines.zh: 我信任的人不多，你算一个
lines.en: I trust few. You might be one.
Our rule: save the living first.

lines.zh: 别死在我前面，太难看了
lines.en: Don't die before me; it'd look bad.
Fly beside me; don't fall behind.

lines.zh: 我记着每一个倒下的队友
lines.en: I remember every teammate who fell.
That's not romance. That's a partner.

lines.zh: 活着回来，我们再谈别的
lines.en: Come back alive; then we'll talk.
One sweep of my hand and I have it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我懒得弯腰
lines.en: Things on the ground — I don't bend for them.
I flick it up and take a look.
This is mine now. Don't ask.
So light I can't feel it.
I pinch it between two fingers.
Dropped is dropped. Worthless.
You want it? I'll toss it to you.
This junk will not earn me any glory.
This won't help in a fight.

lines.zh: 你的气动了一下，我看见了
lines.en: Your ki shifted. I saw it.
I'm locking on. Don't wander.
My palm lights up.
Just one target. Simple.

lines.zh: 你站的位置不错，方便我出手
lines.en: Your position suits my attack.
I won't count down. I just start.
No one else around. Perfect.
I turn sideways and drop my weight.
I can read every move you make.
Forty thousand is plenty for this.

lines.zh: 我锁定的是气，不是你的人
lines.en: I'm locked on your ki, not your body.
Don't think you can run.
I smile before I strike.
You'll do.
I strike first — don't blame me.

lines.zh: 准备好了吗，我可不等人
lines.en: Ready? I don't wait.
Your ki drifts half an inch to the right.
You go left; I'm already there.
This range is just right.
Forty thousand. Enough to read you.
The moment you stop, I move.
The ki blast is charged.
No rush; rushing makes me miss.
There's a hitch in your step.
I rise so you have to look up.

lines.zh: 我换了个角度，再换一个
lines.en: I change angles, then change again.

lines.zh: 我的红色皮肤，在风里发烫。
lines.en: My red skin burns in the wind.

lines.zh: 我在等你出手，好看破绽
lines.en: I wait for your strike to find the gap.
You'll dodge this the first time.
I smile. That's the signal.
One more second and I'm on you.
My shadow arrives first; I follow.
Don't look back. I'm behind you.
On the third second, my fist arrives.
Ki blast. Catch.
Small blasts, rapid, like rain.
I strike from your flank.
This elbow is fast; you won't see it.
My kick lands on your chest.

lines.zh: 粉碎球擦着你的肩过去。
lines.en: My Crusher Ball grazes your shoulder.
I strike and withdraw; no grappling.
Three shots, the last the heaviest.
Your guard slipped half an inch.
I punch with a grin; it looks better.
This one's the Crusher Ball.
Don't just stand there. Dodge.
Red skin and a shock of white hair.
That'll stay with you a while.
After this I still have to fix my hair.
You take hits better than I thought.

lines.zh: 我从天上来，落在你面前
lines.en: I come down from the sky and land before you.
Dust rings out where I land.
I was sent. No reason needed.

lines.zh: 这里的重力比我想的轻
lines.en: Gravity here is lighter than I expected.

lines.zh: 我先看了看四周，记下地形
lines.en: I scan the area and note the terrain.

lines.zh: 我的气一放开，鸟都飞了
lines.en: I release my ki and the birds scatter.
Red skin, white hair. Remember it.

lines.zh: 我的队伍在别处，我一个人够
lines.en: My squad's elsewhere. I'm enough alone.

lines.zh: 这星球的重力，我记住了。
lines.en: I will remember this planet's gravity.
I land on one knee.
The wind dies; I stand up.

lines.zh: 我抬手看了看自己的拳头
lines.en: I raise my hand and look at my fist.

lines.zh: 任务开始，我先找个目标
lines.en: Mission begins. First, a target.
The air smells unfamiliar.
I laugh once to hide my nerves.
This body's in good shape.

lines.zh: 我把气压在最低，等人上钩
lines.en: I keep my ki low, waiting for someone to bite.
I'm here, so there'll be a fight.
Flame runs up my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下来，砸得很实
lines.en: I drop out of the air and hit hard.
Once submerged, my ki scatters.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我推开了
lines.en: The blast wave shoves me aside.
Something passed through my thigh.
A force coils around my ki.
My ki is dropping. I need to recharge.
Lightning hits me and I go numb all over.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我一路坠
lines.en: No ground below; I keep falling.
